# ztna_subnet (Resource)

Subnet resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ztna_connector_group" "test_group" {
  name        = "terraform-test-connector-group"
  description = "Temporary group created by terraform test"
}

resource "ztna_subnet" "example" {
  name        = "terraform-test-subnet"
  ip_subnets  = "10.0.0.0/24"
  group       = ztna_connector_group.test_group.oid
  description = "Made by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) A comma separated list of connector group IDs
- `ip_subnets` (String) IPv4 subnet in CIDR notation (x.x.x.x/y)
- `name` (String) Name of the IP Subnet rule.

It can only be 64 characters long
and contain unicode text, space, dash, or underscore, or period.

### Optional

- `app_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the IP subnet rule is enabled.

If omitted, defaults to false.
- `description` (String) Description
- `icmp_allowed` (Boolean) Whether ICMP is allowed for this IP subnet rule.

If omitted, defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) Created time
- `oid` (String) Id of the entry.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `updated_time` (String) Updated time


## Import

The following command can be used to import a resource not managed by Terraform:

```bash
terraform import scm_ztna_subnet.example folder:::id
```

or

```bash
terraform import scm_ztna_subnet.example :snippet::id
```

or

```bash
terraform import scm_ztna_subnet.example ::device:id
```

**Note:** Please provide just one of folder, snippet, or device for the import command.
